# SARAFAN · Сарафан

> A static library of 1080 × 1350 HTML social cards, brand rules, local fonts, reusable assets, and Russian publication examples. Use it to create posts in the SARAFAN design system.

Start with the guide and brand rules, then fetch only the relevant template files. All relative links resolve from this directory, including when hosted at a subpath. Card source markup is inside HTML `<template>` elements in index.html; rendered previews alone do not expose those sources. Intro, transition, and club-salon are style references. Explicit user instructions take precedence over project defaults.

## Start here

- [Agent guide](docs/agent-guide.md): Russian workflow, complete template source map, local download, dependencies, and export checks.
- [Project instructions](AGENTS.md): Concise instructions for coding agents working in a local copy.
- [Brand rules](docs/design-system.md): Palette, typography, spacing, composition, and restrictions.
- [Machine file catalog](agent-manifest.json): schemaVersion 1; paths, media types, byte sizes, SHA-256 hashes, templates, posts, and separately listed archives. Resolve paths against base `./` beside this file.

## Templates and publications

- [Expert template](docs/expert-template.md): Five cards; preserve the local Geist v1.6 font and source line breaks.
- [Event template](docs/event-template.md): One photo cover and three supplied-poster containers.
- [Club templates](docs/club-templates.md): Club event posters and the salon style reference.
- [Intro style reference](docs/intro-reference.md): Seven brand introduction cards.
- [Transition style reference](docs/transition-reference.md): Six story cards.
- [New posts](docs/new-posts.md): Standalone HTML cards, media paths, registry format, and crop/cover data.

## Tokens and local files

- [Design tokens JSON](downloads/tokens.json): Machine-readable colors, color combinations, and typography derived from design-system-data.js.
- [Design tokens CSS](downloads/tokens.css): Namespaced CSS custom properties and legacy aliases for existing cards' inherited variables.
- [Local font declarations](downloads/fonts.css): Font-face definitions with paths relative to this CSS file.
- [Downloader](scripts/download-kit.py): Python 3, standard library only; SITE_URL --dest DIRECTORY, optional repeated --include PATH_OR_PREFIX and --overwrite; preserves paths and verifies hashes.
- [Asset provenance and licenses](downloads/README.md): Existing local assets and font license information, including the unresolved CoFo license.

## Optional

- [Library overview](README.md): Human-oriented project documentation.
- [Static agent page](agents.html): Clickable resource list and template source map without JavaScript.
